Focus

The power of one habit at a time

By Leo · 4 min read · mock page for Skill Recorder evals

When we try to change everything at once, we usually change nothing. Our attention is finite, and spreading it thin across a dozen new routines guarantees that none of them take root.

Focus on one habit at a time to make it stick.

Pick the smallest version of the habit you can imagine. Do it every day, at the same time, until it feels automatic. Only then add the next one.

Consistency beats intensity. A quiet, repeatable practice will outlast any burst of motivation.
